description: Multiplayer window — deliberately empty. FRAMEWORK.md security doctrine #2/#3: the online window is a webview onto https://www.ahousedividedgame.com and must never get Tauri IPC, fs, dialog, or shell. This file exists to make the zero-grant explicit and reviewable; deleting it would have the same effect (a window with no matching capability gets no permissions), but leaving it here means a future edit can't accidentally widen the online window's surface without touching a file whose whole purpose is staying empty.
